name: pariksha-monorepo
description: Pariksha — Full-Stack Examination and Intelligent Proctoring Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pariksha/api" "npm run dev -w @pariksha/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pariksha/shared && npm run build -w @pariksha/api && npm run build -w @pariksha/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pariksha/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pariksha/api && npm run typecheck -w @pariksha/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pariksha/shared && npm run test -w @pariksha/api && npm run test -w @pariksha/web
